about_the_game:
Toto is an adorable little animal, but it's always busy—work, short breaks, long breaks, all at your command! When you work, Toto works too; when you rest, it relaxes alongside you. Paired with the Pomodoro timer feature, it helps you manage your time effectively, balancing work and rest to keep you from feeling fatigued

🐾 Three work modes, switch freely:

✍️ Typing on the computer: Click to turn it into coins, earn money while typing!

🎣 Happy Fishing: Hit hidden letters to speed up the hooking and reap surprises～

🌱 Random Planting: Toto automatically sows seeds, with different crops sprouting up each time!

Remember to let Toto rest at the right time, as it will protest by "lying down" when its stamina hits zero!

The coins you earn can be used to purchase various blind boxes—unlock rare seeds, flowers, furniture, and even exchange for new houses! Collect all the illustrated books to achieve the perfect ending～

🌟 Easy Idle Mode | Soothing Visuals | Pomodoro Companion | Create an Ideal Life with Toto!
